title: Every Expert Counts: ExactMoE for Memory-Efficient W4A16 Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.15383v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models reduce arithmetic by activating only a small subset of experts per token, yet deployment still requires storing and moving the full expert bank. We present ExactMoE, an inference design that applies symmetric group-128 four-bit weight quantization only to routed experts, stores those experts in kernel-native MARLIN form in pinned host memory, and executes all selected experts through a configurable GPU-resident slot cache and fused grouped MoE kernels. The router, attention, embeddings, normalization layers, and language-model head remain in BF16. "Exact" refers to complete expert availability and an unchanged top-k routing procedure: no expert is pruned, substituted, or forced to execute on the CPU. translated_title: 每个专家都重要：ExactMoE用于内存高效的W4A16推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15383v1 公告类型：新 摘要：稀疏混合专家（MoE）语言模型通过仅激活每个标记的一小部分专家来减少计算量，但部署时仍需存储和移动整个专家库。我们提出了ExactMoE，一种推理设计，仅对路由专家应用对称的组大小为128的4位权重量化，将这些专家以内核原生的MARLIN形式存储在固定主机内存中，并通过可配置的GPU驻留插槽缓存和融合的分组MoE内核执行所有选定的专家。路由器、注意力、嵌入、归一化层和语言模型头部保持在BF16格式。“Exact”指的是完整的专家可用性和不变的top-k路由过程：没有专家被剪枝、替换或被迫在CPU上执行。这并不意味着与BF16模型在数值上完全一致。在OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-Instruct上，在单个NVIDIA L4上评估，16插槽配置将峰值保留的GPU内存从14.168降至（数值未完整给出）。
tldr: ExactMoE通过仅对路由专家应用4位量化并存储在主机内存中，结合GPU插槽缓存和融合内核，在不改变路由或剪枝专家的前提下，大幅减少MoE推理的GPU内存占用。
en_tdlr: ExactMoE reduces GPU memory usage for MoE inference by applying 4-bit quantization only to routed experts stored in host memory, with GPU slot caching and fused kernels, without pruning or altering routing.
